title: Lab 02 Report: AI-Assisted Software Requirements Prioritization

sections.title: 1. Prioritization Decision Before Coding
sections.placeholder: Explain why user votes alone are insufficient for release planning. State how you expect historical NLP evidence, business value, strategic fit, effort, and accessibility impact to influence the decision.

sections.title: 2. Vote-Only Baseline
sections.placeholder: Document the baseline ranking, selected requirements, budget usage, and the visible product features shown in the Spotify-style preview.

sections.title: 3. AI-Assisted Prioritization Method
sections.placeholder: Describe the supplied Multinomial Naive Bayes model, the meaning of p_high and confidence, and your implementation of the hybrid priority score.

sections.title: 4. Release Comparison and Visual Evidence
sections.placeholder: Compare the baseline and AI-assisted release plans. Identify which visible interface features appeared or disappeared, report budget usage, and include supporting screenshots or execution evidence.

sections.title: 5. Critical Analysis
sections.placeholder: Interpret the validation metrics and sensitivity experiment. Discuss historical-data bias, confidence, implementation cost, accessibility, explainability, and whether the AI model should have final authority.

sections.title: 6. Conclusion
sections.placeholder: Summarize what the experiment demonstrates about using AI to prioritize software requirements under realistic release constraints.
